description: Find categories by name or definition and apps by name, word by word: 'best free ai companion', 'apps like calm' (the categories Calm is ranked in), 'chat gpt'. Filler words (best, free, app, like) are ignored. Returns summaries with compact apps; follow up with get_category or get_app. When nothing matches every word, the categories matching some of them come back with a hint.

made_for_iphone_duo.description: true: only apps with Apple's Made for iPhone Duo badge (iPhone Duo screenshots on the listing), best tier first, then most rated; query may be empty to list them all, and no categories come back

query.description: free text, e.g. 'ai girlfriend', 'period tracker', 'apps like calm'
